 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is expected to release the MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 on 15 November 2026 for the Constable (G.D.) Recruitment Test. Candidates who applied for the 7,500 Constable GD vacancies can access their hall tickets from the official portal once released. The written examination is scheduled to begin on 19 November 2026.
 Candidates can also refer to the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notification for complete details, including vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, the selection process, and application dates.
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Release Date
 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is expected to release the MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 on 15 November 2026. Candidates appearing for the Constable (G.D.) Recruitment Test can download their hall tickets from the official website at esb.mp.gov.in using their application number and date of birth.
 The written examination is scheduled to begin on 19 November 2026 . Candidates are advised to download their admit cards as soon as the link becomes active to avoid last-minute technical issues.
 The examination city information is expected around 12 November 2026, allowing candidates to check their allotted examination city before downloading the hall ticket.
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Overview
 MPESB will conduct the Constable (G.D.) Recruitment Test across multiple dates and shifts. Candidates must carry a printed admit card along with a prescribed original photo identity proof to gain entry into the examination venue. Key schedule and event details are outlined in the table below.

 How to Download MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026
 Candidates can download their MP Police Constable GD hall tickets through the official MPESB website after the link is activated. Follow the step-by-step procedure given below:
 Visit the official MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in .
 Open the Admit Card or Test Admit Card section.
 Find the Police Constable (G.D.) Recruitment Test 2026.
 Click the Test Admit Card download link.
 Enter your registered application number.
 Enter your date of birth in the required format.
 Enter the first two letters of your mother's name and the last four digits of your Aadhaar number, if requested.
 Complete the additional verification displayed on the portal.
 Click Search or Submit.
 Check your examination date, centre, shift, and reporting time.
 Download the admit card and take a clear printout.
 Direct Link: MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 - Official Website 
 Details Mentioned on MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026
 After downloading their hall tickets, candidates should carefully verify the personal and examination details printed on the document. The admit card contains the following information:
 Candidate Name
 Application Number or Roll Number
 Candidate Photograph
 Examination Date
 Allotted Examination Shift
 Reporting Time
 Gate-Closing Time
 Examination Centre Name
 Complete Examination Centre Address
 Important Examination Instructions
 Candidates preparing for other Madhya Pradesh government examinations can also refer to the MPESB Revised Exam Calendar 2026 to check the schedules of upcoming recruitment examinations.
 MP Police Constable Exam Date 2026 and Shift Timings
 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is scheduled to conduct the Police Constable (G.D.) Recruitment Test 2026 from 19 November 2026. The examination will be conducted in multiple shifts across designated examination centres in Madhya Pradesh.
 Candidates should check their individual admit cards for the confirmed examination date, shift timings, reporting time and gate-closing time. The examination city information is expected to be available before the release of the admit card.
